Category Description: Wood pressed and cold pressed cooking oils, made on a traditional lakdi ghani (also called marachekku or chekku) at low temperature, so the aroma and nutrients survive. Unrefined, unfiltered and never blended.
Description: Traditional lakdi ghani groundnut oil, also known as marachekku or chekku oil, with a rich nutty aroma. Ideal for everyday Indian cooking and deep frying.
Cold extracted white sesame (til) oil, pressed on a wooden ghani. Light and versatile, traditionally used for cooking, oil pulling and abhyanga massage.
Robust black sesame oil pressed on a wooden lakdi ghani. Deeply aromatic and naturally rich in antioxidants.
Unrefined wood pressed coconut oil with a natural sweet aroma. Solidifies below 24°C, which is normal. Suitable for cooking, hair and skin.
Pure wood pressed almond oil. Light and nutrient dense, used both in the kitchen and for skin and hair care.
Sharp, pungent kachi ghani black mustard oil, cold pressed on a wooden ghani. A staple of Bengali, Bihari and North Indian kitchens.
Kachi ghani yellow mustard oil, milder than black mustard with a clean golden colour. Great for tempering, pickling and everyday cooking.
First press extra virgin olive oil. Best used raw over salads, dips and finished dishes.
Light, neutral tasting wood pressed sunflower oil. A everyday all rounder that does not mask flavours.
Traditional kardi oil, wood pressed and unrefined. Light bodied with a clean finish.
Hand churned A2 bilona cow ghee, made the traditional way from cultured curd rather than cream. Grainy texture and a deep roasted aroma.

Category Description: Cold pressed carrier oils and single ingredient skincare, with nothing added and nothing refined out. Suitable for hair oiling, scalp massage and everyday skin care.
Description: Thick, cold pressed castor oil. Traditionally used for hair growth, lashes, brows and dry skin.
Lightweight argan oil rich in vitamin E. Absorbs quickly, used for frizz control and facial hydration.
Amla (Indian gooseberry) oil, cold pressed. A classic remedy for scalp health and premature greying.
Kalonji oil, cold pressed and unrefined. Valued in traditional medicine for immunity, skin and hair.
Pure neem oil with its characteristic sharp aroma. Used for acne prone skin, scalp care and as a natural pest deterrent.
Alsi oil, cold pressed to protect its omega 3 content. Use raw, never heated.
Pure steam distilled rose water with no added fragrance or preservative. A natural toner and face mist.
Natural multani mitti clay. A time tested face pack for oily skin and gentle deep cleansing.
Soothing aloe vera gel for sunburn, irritation and daily hydration. Light and non sticky.

Category Description: Concentrated steam distilled essential oils for aromatherapy, diffusers and diluted topical use. Always blend with a carrier oil before applying to skin.
Description: Steam distilled rosemary oil, popular for scalp massage and hair thinning when diluted in a carrier oil.
Bright, citrus lemon essential oil. Uplifting in a diffuser and a natural cleaning booster.
Sharp, cooling eucalyptus oil. Commonly used in steam inhalation and for congestion relief.
Tea tree oil with natural antibacterial properties. Used on blemishes and dandruff, always diluted.

Category Description: Hand picked Kashmiri dry fruits and superfoods, sourced direct from growers and sold unpolished and unbleached.
Description: Genuine Kashmiri mamra badam. Smaller and oilier than commercial almonds, with a much richer taste.
Light coloured Kashmiri akhrot kernels, hand shelled and unbleached.
Naturally tart dried cranberries. Good in trail mixes, baking and breakfast bowls.
Pure Kashmiri Mongra saffron with deep red threads and a strong natural aroma. No colouring added.
